title: OTHRYS OS tablet workspace priority layout
goal: Use the second live tablet screenshot to make the central workspace primary and Progress a usable secondary inspector.
laws: The center workspace must remain the dominant tablet surface.
Progress must not permanently consume roughly one third of landscape width.
Progress remains directly accessible with one touch.
The inspector must remain scrollable and readable.
No mission, model, Trust Canal or execution semantics change.
No external assets or Panda proprietary code are introduced.
Existing read-only and Refine boundaries remain unchanged.

slices.goal: Rebalance tablet workspace and inspector proportions.
Reduce duplicated inspector chrome and preserve touch access.
Independently verify regression and authority boundaries.
